name: Elvira 2 XL
notes: The neutral labs Elmyra 2 in full, after its manual (v2.4): per voice touch, ENV, drone, MOD with all eleven MODP programs (0 DETUNE .. 1 DJ in tenths), CHRM, scales and EDOs, octave, tune follow, an 8-step sequence; the twelve filter types, reversed routing, delay to 1.6 s with color and sync, reverb, OUCH, two LFOs to audio rate with S&H / S&G and sync, ATT, ADD, and the jacks as ports. A choice of N is a 0..1 row in N even steps. Not here: external audio, bit flipping, recording. Browser only
